title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 24 V, Vout = 5 V, Iout = 25 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 3.52 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0043 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 30 ns; gate charge Qg = 43 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.6 C/W, RthCS = 0.48 C/W, Ta = 35 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0051 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0101 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 8.0 uH, output capacitor C = 223 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 5.0 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 50 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 125 C; eta >= 96.5%; fan noise <= 40 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 45 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 15.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 11.2 / 5.6 / 3.92 / 2.8 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 1.88
  HS-2: Rsa = 7.46 / 3.73 / 2.61 / 1.87 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 4.44
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.13 / 2.43 / 1.68 / 1.21 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.98
  HS-4: Rsa = 3.55 / 1.68 / 1.17 / 0.84 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 12.10
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.43 / 1.12 / 0.79 / 0.56 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 17.28
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.68 / 0.79 / 0.56 / 0.42 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 31.90

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 28.0], [7.0, 16.8], [11.2, 8.4], [14.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.85
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 42.0], [18.7, 25.2], [29.9, 12.6], [37.3, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.82
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 37.3], [32.7, 22.4], [52.2, 11.2], [65.3, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 7.36
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 84.0], [51.3, 50.4], [82.1, 25.2], [102.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 12.88
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 102.6], [74.6, 61.6], [119.4, 30.8], [149.3, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 17.67

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
